svg.title: For a reversed link use the equivalent reversed multiplication in (TS10). The current is gauge covariant at the source, so the covariance of J and ν is exactly the one required there. The step h = θx−1/24, with its fixed node multiples, eventually satisfies the stronger chart condition 64D ≤θ; thus it also satisfies the 8D ≤θ flag condition of (TS10). Let Le,tih(U) be this lens with the finite stock exponent, and sum over the active links, color basis indices and nodes: M(U) = 1 X X i<m wi Le,tih(U). (TS11)
